scientific_interpretation_note: Conditional group-blocked resampling conditions on all 6 categories appearing among the 53 sampled validation groups (rejecting draws lacking Serrated adenoma [2 groups] or Normal [3 groups]). Conditional intervals ensure a fixed 6-class Macro-F1 / Balanced Accuracy definition across all 2,000 replicates, whereas unconditional intervals reflect natural finite-sample group dropout (~17.7% of draws). Empirical bootstrap proportions (prop_bootstrap_delta_gt_0) summarize resampling variability and are neither Bayesian posterior probabilities nor confirmatory hypothesis tests.
